programs.title: On the Wasteland
programs.desc: Once a simple herdsman, Sonam Tsering is now a man of great acclaim in his hometown. Hear the inspiring story of how his unwavering dedication led him on a new path to greener pastures—and the Lu Xun Literary Prize.
